## What this changes

A sentence or two. If it fixes an issue, write `Fixes #123`.

## Why

What was wrong, or what was missing.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Language change (needs an accepted LEP — link it)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Tooling or CI

## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest` passes
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes
- [ ] `python tools/record_examples.py` reports no changes
- [ ] New behaviour has tests; a bug fix has a regression test
- [ ] SPEC.md updated, if the language changed
- [ ] docs/spec/grammar.ebnf updated, if the syntax changed
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under Unreleased
- [ ] No credentials, keys or personal files are committed

## What I did not do

Anything you left out on purpose, and why. This saves the reviewer guessing.
